mbm-2324.clue: I mark my last turn with breakfast.
mbm-2324.quote: Halfway up the ridge I find a flat rock and peel an orange in one coil. I take the peel home. My sister unrolls it on the map to guess how far I walked.

mbm-2325.clue: I earned a stamp on both elbows.
mbm-2325.quote: Our martial arts teacher let us pick a stamp after we learned a safe roll. I got a green frog. My son wanted one too, so we rolled about on the rug till our giggles woke the dog.
